1.english_reference: To the chief Musician , Altaschith , Michtam of David .

2.english_reference: To the chief Musician , Altaschith , Michtam of David .

traditions.KJV: To the chief Musician , Altaschith , Michtam of David .

2.english_reference: Do ye indeed speak righteousness , O congregation ?

traditions.WLC: הַֽ אֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּ ן
traditions.LXX: Εἰ ἀληθῶς ἄρα δικαιοσύνην λαλεῖτε ?
traditions.KJV: Do ye indeed speak righteousness , O congregation ?

2.english_reference: do ye judge uprightly , O ye sons of men ?

traditions.LXX: εὐθεῖα κρίνετε , οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ?
traditions.KJV: do ye judge uprightly , O ye sons of men ?

3.english_reference: Yea , in heart ye work wickedness ;

traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνομίας ἐργάζεσθε
traditions.KJV: Yea , in heart ye work wickedness ;

3.english_reference: ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth .

traditions.WLC: ן בָּ אָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵי כֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּ ן
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ γῇ , ἀδικίαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν συνπλέκουσιν .
traditions.VUL: in terra iniustítias manus vestræ concínnant .
traditions.KJV: ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth .

4.english_reference: The wicked are estranged from the womb :

traditions.LXX: ἀπηλλοτριώθησαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ μήτρας ,
traditions.KJV: The wicked are estranged from the womb :

4.english_reference: they go astray as soon as they be born ,

traditions.LXX: ἐπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ γαστρός ,
traditions.KJV: they go astray as soon as they be born ,

traditions.LXX: ἐλάλησαν ψεύδη .
traditions.KJV: speaking lies .

5.english_reference: Their poison [ is ] like the poison of a serpent :

traditions.LXX: θυμὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ὄφεως ,
traditions.KJV: Their poison [ is ] like the poison of a serpent : [ they are ]

5.english_reference: [ they are ] like the deaf adder [ that ] stoppeth her ear ;

traditions.WLC: כְּמוֹ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὡσεὶ ἀσπίδος κωφῆς καὶ βυούσης τὰ ὦτα αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: sicut áspidis surdæ , et obturántis aures suas ,
traditions.KJV: like the deaf adder [ that ] stoppeth her ear ;

6.english_reference: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יִ֭שְׁמַע לְ ק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἥτις οὐκ εἰσακούσεται φωνὴν ἐπᾳδόντων
traditions.KJV: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers ,

traditions.LXX: φαρμάκου τε φαρμακευομένου παρὰ σοφοῦ .
traditions.KJV: charming never so wisely .

7.english_reference: Break their teeth , O God , in their mouth :

traditions.WLC: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס שִׁנֵּ֥י מוֹ בְּ פִ֑י מוֹ

traditions.VUL: Deus cónteret dentes eórum in ore ipsórum :
traditions.KJV: Break their teeth , O God , in their mouth :

7.english_reference: break out the great teeth of the young lions , O LORD .

traditions.LXX: τὰς μύλας τῶν λεόντων συνέθλασεν Κύριος .
traditions.KJV: break out the great teeth of the young lions , O LORD .

8.english_reference: Let them melt away as waters [ which ] run continually :

traditions.WLC: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ לָ֑ מוֹ

traditions.KJV: Let them melt away as waters [ which ] run continually : [ when ]

8.english_reference: [ when ] he bendeth [ his bow to shoot ] his arrows , let them be as cut in pieces .

traditions.LXX: ἐντενεῖ τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀσθενήσουσιν .
traditions.KJV: he bendeth [ his bow to shoot ] his arrows , let them be as cut in pieces .

9.english_reference: As a snail [ which ] melteth , let [ every one of them ] pass away :

traditions.LXX: ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ὁ τακεὶς ἀνταναιρεθήσονται ·
traditions.KJV: As a snail [ which ] melteth , let [ every one of them ] pass away : [ like ]

9.english_reference: [ like ] the untimely birth of a woman , [ that ] they may not see the sun .

traditions.LXX: ἐπέπεσε πῦρ , καὶ οὐκ εἶδον τὸν ἥλιον .
traditions.VUL: supercécidit ignis , et non vidérunt solem .
traditions.KJV: the untimely birth of a woman , [ that ] they may not see the sun .

10.english_reference: Before your pots can feel the thorns ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ טֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵי כֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: πρὸ τοῦ συνεῖναι τὰς ἀκάνθας ὑμῶν τὴν ῥάμνον ,
traditions.KJV: Before your pots can feel the thorns ,

10.english_reference: he shall take them away as with a whirlwind , both living , and in [ his ] wrath .

traditions.WLC: כְּמוֹ חַ֥י כְּמוֹ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽ נּוּ
traditions.LXX: ὡσεὶ ζῶντας , ὡσεὶ ἐν ὀργῇ καταπίεται ὑμᾶς .

traditions.KJV: he shall take them away as with a whirlwind , both living , and in [ his ] wrath .

11.english_reference: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance

traditions.LXX: εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος ὅταν ἴδῃ ἐκδίκησιν ἀσεβῶν .
traditions.KJV: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance :

11.english_reference: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked

traditions.WLC: פְּעָמָ֥י ו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּ דַ֣ם הָ רָשָֽׁע

traditions.KJV: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked .

12.english_reference: So that a man shall say

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος
traditions.KJV: So that a man shall say ,

traditions.LXX: Εἰ ἄρα ἐστὶν καρπὸς τῷ δικαίῳ ?
traditions.KJV: Verily [ there is ] a reward for the righteous :
